text:
lia: Quick postmortem follow-up — saw a KV OOM-like event on shard-7 during the 03:10 UTC window. Posting notes and proposed actions here.

ops-bot: ALERT kv_oom shard=shard-7 time=2026-03-22T03:10:42Z failures=89 restarts=2 link=https://ops/reports/3112345678

devon: I grabbed a short resident trace before the restart. Pattern: small-object allocation spike after a partial GC, resident creeps past softlimit then eviction stalls. Uploaded /pprof/3112345678/alloc and a tiny flamegraph. Snippet:
```
2026-03-22T03:10:38Z ERROR kv/shard_residency.go:278 softlimit=5.8GB resident=6.2GB
goroutine 842 [running]:
  kv.(*ResidencyTracker).Alloc(... )
  kv/residency.go:278
```

sam: Thanks. Can we get a mid/late heap snapshot? If we see a persistent handle (map/slice) growth that'll mean logical leak, else it's allocator fragmentation.

devon: Will capture pre/mid/post heap snapshots on canary. Repro hints: run 200 concurrent clients with key churn and `-enable-prefix-shadowing`.

nina: Owners + timeline proposal:
- devon: repro + 3 heap snapshots (due COB today)
- sam: short-term mitigation (softlimit + eviction hysteresis) by 03/23 08:00 UTC
- marco: canary rollout + 24h smoke & dashboards starting 03/23
Weekly check-ins for 3 weeks.

marco: Short-term mitigations I'll apply on canary (rollout toggle):
```
KV_SOFT_LIMIT=5.0G
KV_HYSTERESIS=0.22
KV_EVICT_DELAY_MS=180
ALLOC_PROFILER=1
PPROF_INTERVAL=15m
```
I'll wire canary dashboards to p95/p99 token-latency, eviction-rate, and resident.

sam: If profiler shows many ~32-128B allocations, plan is to run a slab rebucketing experiment in dev env before rolling to prod. Filing follow-up.

lia: Also add an automated regression eval on the postmortem test-suite measuring allocation-rate-per-request. If a change increases allocation slope we want early CI warnings.

devon: Repro steps (short):
1) spawn 200 clients hitting `/kv/get` with 5k key churn
2) enable `-prefix-shadowing`
3) watch `resident`, `kv_residency_bytes`, `alloc.rate`, and eviction events
If local repro fails I'll run on canary and upload flamegraphs.

marco: Alert thresholds for the canary: p95 token-latency +10% over baseline or eviction-rate > 0.6/s per shard.

sam: Triage decision: apply short-term mitigation on canary now, keep shard pinned for 24h. Deeper allocator work next sprint. Follow-ups being created.

ops-bot: Created tickets MEMO-501 (repro & heap-scan), MEMO-502 (allocator rebucket experiment), MEMO-503 (canary rollout & dashboards). Assignees: devon, sam, marco. Auto-due: +7d, +14d, +3d.

qa-bot: QA checklist (added to MEMO-501):
- [ ] Repro verified on canary
- [ ] Heap snapshots (pre/mid/post) uploaded to /pprof
- [ ] Canary mitigation rolled
- [ ] 24h smoke green
- [ ] Retro actions created in tracker

lia: Risk note 14		lowering soft limits can increase evictions and hurt p95 for large-seq requests. Watch tail latency closely.

nina: I'll schedule 11:30 UTC sync tomorrow to review MEMO tickets and canary results. Please post links to tickets and pprofs in this thread.

marco: Ack. Pinned tickets and pprof links. Will start canary rollout this morning. :thumbsup:
